capabilities: Decompose annual plans into daily check-in items
Track goals across Today, Plans, Tasks and Achievements pages
Group tasks in Kanban and Gantt views with drag-to-reschedule bars
Aggregate week, month and year progress by automatic date windows
Award check-in streaks and bronze/silver/gold badges
extras: UI is currently in Chinese; a fuller illustrated guide is in docs/USAGE.md (Chinese). Fully local: no network calls or telemetry.
motivation: The author wanted a plan to be one flow instead of a pile of tables, with today's check-in and summary at the visual center.
problem: Yearly goals, monthly plans and daily check-ins are usually kept as separate datasets that have to be synced by hand.
summary: Obsidian planning system that decomposes annual plans into daily check-in items and tracks goals across Today, Plans, Tasks and Achievements pages.
